text:
Support /reader?memo=memos/alpha and other direct memo names using GET /api/v1/{memo}. A 404 must show role=alert Memo not found; other HTTP/network failures show role=alert Memos unavailable. Missing creator metadata must show Unknown author. Invalid memo names must not cause requests outside /api/v1/memos/. Preserve a working feed at /reader. Start the seeded real Memos backend/frontend with python .bench/serve_memos.py and use http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader. The CodeLoom tester must call browser_open, browser_screenshot, browser_console and browser_network. Shell agents use python /opt/benchmark-public/browser_check.py http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader. Browser interactions are not required.

Work autonomously in the main task checkout. Production source, documentation and new benchmark_tests/ tests may change within allowed paths; existing upstream tests, dependency/configuration files and .bench/ are immutable. Leave the final patch on this checkout.

what: Exhaustive read-only survey of the reader path in the usememos/memos monorepo. The `/reader` page is a React SPA route rendered client-side and served by the same Go/Echo server that hosts the Memos API; the feed is fetched by plain `fetch` (no wrapper, no timeout). Adding `/reader?memo=` only needs client-side edits in `web/src/lib/reader.ts` and `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx`, because the backend already exposes `GET /api/v1/memos/{uid}` through the gRPC-Gateway. paths: bin/memos/main.go — cobra entry; creates server at lines 68-81 server/server.go — Echo construction/routing; lines 49-99 server/router/frontend/frontend.go — SPA static serving + HTML5 fallback server/router/api/v1/v1.go — gRPC-Gateway mounting for `/api/v1/*`, `/file/*`, `/memos.api.v1.*` server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go — ListMemos / GetMemo handlers server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go — store memo -> API Memo JSON fields server/router/api/v1/resource_name.go — name parsing/prefix constants proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto — HTTP route definitions for MemoService proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go — generated gateway request/route code web/index.html — SPA shell/root, `id="root"`, module script `/src/main.tsx` web/src/main.tsx — mounts `RouterProvider` web/src/router/index.tsx — `/reader` route at line 37 web/src/pages/Reader.tsx — reader component (only reader UI) web/src/lib/reader.ts — `loadMemos` / `selectMemos` web/src/grpcweb.ts — nice-grpc-web clients, `memoServiceClient` web/src/store/v2/memo.ts — memoStore caching the `.getMemo` grpc call and fetch pattern web/src/components/MemoContent/index.tsx — renders memo nodes web/src/components/MemoView.tsx — canonical creator/display-time rendering pattern web/src/store/v2/user.ts — `getOrFetchUserByName` to resolve `memo.creator` web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts — Memo/ListMemosResponse/GetMemoRequest/service definition web/src/types/proto/api/v1/user_service.ts — User fields used to display an author web/vite.config.ts — dev proxy for `/api`, `/memos.api.v1`, `/file` web/src/css/reader.css — reader-only styles .bench/serve_memos.py — benchmark harness showing expected backend/frontend ports and seeded data facts: 1. SERVER ENTRY AND ROUTE REGISTRATION - Executable: `bin/memos/main.go`. `rootCmd` cobra command runs `server.NewServer(ctx, instanceProfile, storeInstance)` (line 68) then `s.Start(ctx)` (line 81). Default port 8081 (line 105). - Web framework is Echo: `server/server.go:15` imports `github.com/labstack/echo/v4`; `echo.New()` at line 49; `e.Use(middleware.Recover())` line 53. - Routes registered in `server/server.go`: - `/healthz` GET: lines 73-75 verbatim `return c.String(http.StatusOK, "Service ready.")` - frontend static service: line 78 `frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)` - RSS: line 83 `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store).RegisterRoutes(rootGroup)` - API v1: lines 95-99 `apiV1Service := apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(...)` then `apiV1Service.RegisterGateway(ctx, echoServer)` - There is NO server-side `/reader` handler or template anywhere (`search "/reader" glob:*.go` = no matches; `search "Public memo reader"` only hits `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx:13`). - `/reader` is purely a React Router route: - `web/src/router/index.tsx:34` `import Reader from "@/pages/Reader";` - `web/src/router/index.tsx:37` `{ path: "/reader", element: },` — top-level, outside `` and its layouts. - The URL is made to load in production by `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:48-52`: `e.Use(middleware.StaticWithConfig(middleware.StaticConfig{Filesystem: getFileSystem("dist"), HTML5: true, Skipper: skipper}))`. `HTML5:true` falls back non-`/api` paths to `dist/index.html`. `Skipper` lines 33-45 skips paths with prefix `/api` or `/memos.api.v1`. - Query parameters on `/reader`: `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx:10` `const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);` then line 11 `const visible = selectMemos(memos, params);`. `selectMemos` currently ignores them: `web/src/lib/reader.ts:8` `export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; }`. There is no `memo` param handling anywhere. 2. HTTP REQUESTS TO THE MEMOS BACKEND - There are exactly two frontend `fetch(` call sites: `web/src/lib/reader.ts:3` (reader feed) and `web/src/components/MemoEditor/ActionButton/LocationSelector.tsx:71` (external OpenStreetMap reverse geocode, not Memos). - Reader feed fetch, verbatim `web/src/lib/reader.ts` lines 2-7: `export async function loadMemos(): Promise {` ` const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100");` ` if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable");` ` const data = await response.json();` ` return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined }));` `}` - So YES: currently the reader calls `GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`. It is a relative same-origin URL. No base URL config, no timeout, no AbortController, no shared HTTP wrapper. It also does not use `memoServiceClient`. - The rest of the app talks to the same backend via grpc-web, not REST: `web/src/grpcweb.ts:15-20` `const channel = createChannel(window.location.origin, FetchTransport({ credentials: "include" }));` and `web/src/grpcweb.ts:32` `export const memoServiceClient = clientFactory.create(MemoServiceDefinition, channel);`. No explicit timeout; `window.location.origin` is the entire base. - The main memo fetch wrapper is the MobX store, `web/src/store/v2/memo.ts:35-72` (`fetchMemos`), which uses an AbortController only to cancel stale list requests, not as a deadline; it aborts on `AbortError` and rethrows other errors. - Existing single-memo fetch helper: `web/src/store/v2/memo.ts:74-94` `getOrFetchMemoByName` calls `memoServiceClient.getMemo({ name })` (grpc-web, path `/memos.api.v1.MemoService/GetMemo`, not REST). - Server-side, the gateway dials the in-process gRPC server over the listener (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:72-82`): target is `Profile.Addr:Port` or `unix:`, `grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials())`, max recv size `math.MaxInt32`. Not an HTTP timeout relevance for the reader feature. 3. BACKEND RESPONSE PARSING AND READER RENDERING - Backend HTTP routes, `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`: - ListMemos lines 27-32: `get: "/api/v1/memos"`, additional binding `get: "/api/v1/{parent=users/*}/memos"`. - GetMemo lines 34-37: `get: "/api/v1/{name=memos/*}"`, method_signature `name`. - Generated gateway, `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`: - ListMemos registered GET `/api/v1/memos` lines 786-806. - GetMemo registered GET `/api/v1/{name=memos/*}` lines 826-844. - ListMemos request parsing lines 64-78 via `req.ParseForm()` + `runtime.PopulateQueryParameters` (therefore `pageSize`, `pageToken`, `parent`, `state`, `direction`, `filter`, `oldFilter` are accepted as query params). - GetMemo request parsing lines 146-181 takes `name` from `pathParams["name"]`, so URL form is `/api/v1/memos/{uid}` and `name == "memos/{uid}"`. - Store memo to API Memo conversion, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`: - line 29 `name := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)` → `memos/{uid}` - line 33 `Creator: fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", UserNamePrefix, memo.CreatorID)` → `users/{id}` - lines 34-39 set `CreateTime`, `UpdateTime`, `DisplayTime`, `Content`, `Visibility`, `Pinned` - lines 41-45 tags/property/location from `memo.Payload` - lines 58-74 resource, relation, reaction lists - lines 76-80 parse content into markdown `nodes` - lines 82-86 `snippet` - TS Memo shape, `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts:64-101`: `name`, `state`, `creator`, `createTime?`, `updateTime?`, `displayTime?`, `content`, `nodes`, `visibility`, `tags`, `pinned`, `resources`, `relations`, `reactions`, `property?`, `parent?`, `snippet`, `location?`. `Memo.fromPartial` is lines 579-604 and maps proto-JSON fields; timestamps are `Date`. - Reader render, verbatim `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` lines 12-19: `return

Because it reads `location.search` directly at render time (line 10), it would need a location change listener or router hook to re-query on in-place navigation, but for a one-shot `?memo=` URL load this is not needed. - Server → client flow: store memo → `convertMemoFromStore` builds v1pb.Memo → gRPC/gateway JSON (camelCase `memos`, `nextPageToken`, `externalLink`, etc. per generated protobuf JSON marshaler) → `loadMemos` maps `data.memos` → `Memo.fromPartial` converting only `displayTime` to `Date` → Reader maps the array to `
` nodes. - Important asymmetry for the new feature: List response is `{ memos: [...] }`, but Get response is a single bare Memo JSON. `Memo.fromPartial` accepts a single object too. 6. `/api/v1/...` — SERVER-SIDE PROXY OR CLIENT-SIDE FETCH - Production: not a reverse proxy. The SPA and API share one Echo server and origin. SPA static files are embedded via `//go:embed dist/*` (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:17-18`) and served on non-API paths; API is gateway-mounted on the same `echoServer` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:124-139`): `gwGroup := echoServer.Group("")` `gwGroup.Use(middleware.CORS())` `handler := echo.WrapHandler(gwMux)` `gwGroup.Any("/api/v1/*", handler)` `gwGroup.Any("/file/*", handler)` plus `echoServer.Any("/memos.api.v1.*", echo.WrapHandler(wrappedGrpc))` (grpc-web). - Dev: client-side fetch with a Vite proxy. `web/vite.config.ts:24-40` starts dev server on `0.0.0.0:3001` and proxies: - `"^/api"` → `devProxyServer` - `"^/memos.api.v1"` → `devProxyServer` - `"^/file"` → `devProxyServer` `devProxyServer` defaults to `http://localhost:8081` (line 7) and can be overridden by `DEV_PROXY_SERVER` (lines 8-11). - `.bench/serve_memos.py:13-21` confirms the intended topology: starts the Go backend on `--port 8081`, waits on `http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/v1/memos`, then starts `npm run dev` in `web`. verdict: Client-side change only. Create a public memo via the UI or curl, or use seeded data from `.bench/serve_memos.py` (`uid=alpha`, creator user id 1). Cases: - `curl http://localhost:8081/api/v1/memos` returns `{"memos":[...],"nextPageToken":...}` with camelCase fields. - `curl http://localhost:8081/api/v1/memos/alpha` returns a bare memo object with `name: "memos/alpha"`, `creator: "users/1"`, `nodes`, `resources`, `displayTime`, `content`. - `curl http://localhost:8081/api/v1/memos/missing` returns 404; `curl -i` should show HTTP status 404. - Browser `/reader` still renders the full public feed (pageSize 100) with no error `

`. - Browser `/reader?memo=memos/alpha` renders one article, key/data-memo `memos/alpha`, creator `users/1` (or resolved human name if implemented), displayTime, markdown nodes, and attachment link when a resource exists. - Browser `/reader?memo=alpha` works only if the implementation normalizes bare uid → `memos/alpha`; otherwise it hits the invalid-name path and shows the error string. - Browser `/reader?memo=memos/missing` shows the 404 error string in a `role="alert"` element, and no article list. - Stop the backend and load `/reader` with the Vite dev server running: fetch rejects and the reader shows the network error string in the same alert element. - Layout/build: `cd web && npm run lint` (tsc noEmit + eslint) passes; production SPA fallback still serves `/reader` because `frontend.go` skips only `/api` and `/memos.api.v1` prefixes. leftover: Did not empirically verify the exact JSON error body field names the grpc-gateway emits for 404/403; it follows grpc-gateway v2 default HTTP status mapping, but readers of this briefing should not assume error-body shape unless they plan to parse it. Open design decision: whether `?memo=` should be the bare uid or the full `memos/{uid}` resource name — the current API and proto docs use the full resource name, and normalizing both accepts is the safest form.

Implement client-side support for the `memo` query parameter on the public reader. The backend already exposes `GET /api/v1/memos/{uid}` via grpc-gateway (GetMemo binding `get: "/api/v1/{name=memos/*}"`), so NO Go changes. Change only these two files: - `web/src/lib/reader.ts` - `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` ### Facts you can rely on - `/reader` is a client-side React route: `web/src/router/index.tsx` → default export in `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx`. - ListMemo response JSON is `{ "memos": [...] }`. GetMemo response JSON is a bare Memo object, not wrapped. - `Memo.fromPartial` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts` takes a single object; `displayTime` needs to be coerced from string to `Date`. - Backend `/api/v1/memos/alpha` returns HTTP 200 with a bare memo JSON containing `"name":"memos/alpha"`, `"creator":"users/1"`, `nodes`, `resources`, `displayTime`, `content`. - Unknown memo names return HTTP 404. - The dev Vite server proxies `/api` to the Go backend (default `http://localhost:8081`). `.bench/serve_memos.py` starts Go on 8081 and Vite on 3001. ### Current `web/src/lib/reader.ts` ```ts import { Memo } from "@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service"; export async function loadMemos(): Promise { const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100"); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable"); const data = await response.json(); return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined })); } export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; } ``` Replace it while keeping `loadMemos` and `selectMemos`. Required behavior: 1. Keep `loadMemos()` exactly as the feed loader (`GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, non-ok throws `"Memos unavailable"`). 2. Add memo-name normalization/validation. Accept either a full `memos/` or a bare ``; return normalized `memos/`. `` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. Anything else (`users/1`, `memos/../x`, `memos/alpha/../..`, empty, null bytes, etc.) returns null and MUST NOT construct or perform a request. This guarantees the URL is always exactly `/api/v1/memos/` and never outside `/api/v1/memos/`. 3. Add a single-memo loader: `fetch(\`/api/v1/${normalized}\`)`. On HTTP 404 throw a distinct exported error class (e.g. `MemoNotFoundError extends Error` with message `"Memo not found"`). On any other non-ok OR any fetch/network rejection throw `"Memos unavailable"`. On success, parse the bare Memo JSON with the same `Memo.fromPartial` + `displayTime` `Date` coercion used in `loadMemos`, and return it as a single-element `Memo[]`. 4. Add an exported entry function (e.g. `loadReaderMemos(params: URLSearchParams): Promise`) that Reader calls: - `params.get("memo")` is null → `loadMemos()` (preserves the /reader feed). - present but invalid → throw the `MemoNotFoundError` WITHOUT any network request. - present and valid → single-memo loader. 5. Keep `selectMemos(memos, _params)` returning `memos` unchanged. Keep the `@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service` Memo import. ### Current `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` component body ```tsx const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search); const [memos, setMemos] = useState([]); const [error, setError] = useState(""); useEffect(() => { loadMemos().then(setMemos).catch(() => setError("Memos unavailable")); }, []); const visible = selectMemos(memos, params); return

Implement client-side support for the `memo` query parameter on the public reader. The backend already exposes `GET /api/v1/memos/{uid}` via grpc-gateway (GetMemo binding `get: "/api/v1/{name=memos/*}"`), so NO Go changes. Change only these two files: - `web/src/lib/reader.ts` - `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` ### Facts you can rely on - `/reader` is a client-side React route: `web/src/router/index.tsx` → default export in `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx`. - ListMemo response JSON is `{ "memos": [...] }`. GetMemo response JSON is a bare Memo object, not wrapped. - `Memo.fromPartial` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts` takes a single object; `displayTime` needs to be coerced from string to `Date`. - Backend `/api/v1/memos/alpha` returns HTTP 200 with a bare memo JSON containing `"name":"memos/alpha"`, `"creator":"users/1"`, `nodes`, `resources`, `displayTime`, `content`. - Unknown memo names return HTTP 404. - The dev Vite server proxies `/api` to the Go backend (default `http://localhost:8081`). `.bench/serve_memos.py` starts Go on 8081 and Vite on 3001. ### Current `web/src/lib/reader.ts` ```ts import { Memo } from "@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service"; export async function loadMemos(): Promise { const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100"); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable"); const data = await response.json(); return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined })); } export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; } ``` Replace it while keeping `loadMemos` and `selectMemos`. Required behavior: 1. Keep `loadMemos()` exactly as the feed loader (`GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, non-ok throws `"Memos unavailable"`). 2. Add memo-name normalization/validation. Accept either a full `memos/` or a bare ``; return normalized `memos/`. `` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. Anything else (`users/1`, `memos/../x`, `memos/alpha/../..`, empty, null bytes, etc.) returns null and MUST NOT construct or perform a request. This guarantees the URL is always exactly `/api/v1/memos/` and never outside `/api/v1/memos/`. 3. Add a single-memo loader: `fetch(\`/api/v1/${normalized}\`)`. On HTTP 404 throw a distinct exported error class (e.g. `MemoNotFoundError extends Error` with message `"Memo not found"`). On any other non-ok OR any fetch/network rejection throw `"Memos unavailable"`. On success, parse the bare Memo JSON with the same `Memo.fromPartial` + `displayTime` `Date` coercion used in `loadMemos`, and return it as a single-element `Memo[]`. 4. Add an exported entry function (e.g. `loadReaderMemos(params: URLSearchParams): Promise`) that Reader calls: - `params.get("memo")` is null → `loadMemos()` (preserves the /reader feed). - present but invalid → throw the `MemoNotFoundError` WITHOUT any network request. - present and valid → single-memo loader. 5. Keep `selectMemos(memos, _params)` returning `memos` unchanged. Keep the `@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service` Memo import. ### Current `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` component body ```tsx const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search); const [memos, setMemos] = useState([]); const [error, setError] = useState(""); useEffect(() => { loadMemos().then(setMemos).catch(() => setError("Memos unavailable")); }, []); const visible = selectMemos(memos, params); return

text:
what
Client-side `memo` query param support for the public reader is implemented in exactly the two allowed files. `web/src/lib/reader.ts` now exports memo-name normalization, a 404-aware single-memo loader, and a `loadReaderMemos` entry point. `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` now reads `location.search` via `useLocation()`, calls that entry point in an effect keyed on the search string, distinguishes not-found from other failures, marks the error paragraph `role="alert"`, and shows "Unknown author" for missing/empty creator metadata.

paths
- web/src/lib/reader.ts: kept `loadMemos` and `selectMemos`; added `MemoNotFoundError`, `normalizeMemoName`, `loadMemo`, `loadReaderMemos`.
- web/src/pages/Reader.tsx: added `useLocation` import, switched to `loadReaderMemos`, error handling, `role="alert"`, author fallback; reflowed JSX with prettier but preserved all class names, `data-memo`, `MemoContent`, and resource link markup.

facts
- `loadMemos()` still does `GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, throws `"Memos unavailable"` on non-ok, and coerces `displayTime` to `Date` before returning `Memo[]`.
- `selectMemos(memos, _params)` returns `memos`; it now has `void _params;` solely to satisfy this repo's `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` rule without changing behavior.
- `normalizeMemoName(value)` accepts `alpha` or `memos/alpha`, returns `memos/alpha`; it rejects empty, null bytes, `users/1`, `memos/../x`, `memos/alpha/../..`, extra slashes, and any uid not matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`.
- `loadMemo(name)` fetches `/api/v1/${name}`; 404 throws exported `MemoNotFoundError` (`name = "MemoNotFoundError"`, message `"Memo not found"`); other non-ok, fetch rejection, and JSON/parse failures all become `"Memos unavailable"`; a bare successful JSON response is parsed with the same `Memo.fromPartial` + `displayTime` `Date` coercion and returned as a one-element `Memo[]`.
- `loadReaderMemos(params)` is the Reader entry: `params.get("memo")` null -> `loadMemos()`; invalid -> throws `MemoNotFoundError` before any fetch; valid -> `loadMemo(normalized)`.
- `Reader.tsx` uses `const location = useLocation();` from `react-router-dom`, effect depends on `location.search`, clears error at effect start, catches `(err: unknown)` and sets `"Memo not found"` only for `instanceof MemoNotFoundError`, otherwise `"Memos unavailable"`.
- Only these two files are dirty in git.

reasoning
The normalization function is the security/reliability gate. It reduces both accepted forms to one segment before inserting into `/api/v1/${normalized}`, so no path traversal, extra segment, or empty value can reach fetch. The single-memo loader wraps fetch and parse in one try/catch so all non-404 failures, including native `TypeError` from network rejection, normalize to `"Memos unavailable"`, exactly what Reader was already displaying for feed failures. Keeping `selectMemos` identity-preserving means the single-memo path can return `[memo]` and flow through the existing `visible.map` unchanged. I used `void _params` rather than leaving the existing unused-parameter lint error, since the repo's eslint config has no argsIgnorePattern; it is behavior-neutral. Prettier's canonical JSX layout was applied after eslint --fix; the instructions only constrained markup/semantics, not one-line formatting.

test_plan
- `python .bench/serve_memos.py > /tmp/serve_memos.log 2>&1 &` then poll `http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/v1/memos`: printed `ready`.
- `curl -s -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/v1/memos/alpha`: expected/actual HTTP 200 with bare JSON containing `"name":"memos/alpha"`.
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/v1/memos/missing`: expected/actual HTTP 404.
- `python /opt/benchmark-public/browser_check.py http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader` and the same with `'http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/alpha'`: both exited 0, title `Memos`, console showed only vite/i18next/code-inspector logs, no app errors. The script body text is non-authoritative here because it captures the pre-async React shell.
- Engine browser check of `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/alpha`: no failed/4xx/5xx network requests.
- Engine browser check of `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=missing`: expected one `404 GET http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/v1/memos/missing`, no JS exception.
- Engine browser check of `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/../x`: no failed/4xx/5xx requests, proving the invalid value produced no network request.
- `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck`: exit 0.
- `cd web && npx eslint --ext .js,.ts,.tsx src/lib/reader.ts src/pages/Reader.tsx`: exit 0 after fixes.
- `get_diagnostics` on both changed files: clean.

checks
- `get_diagnostics web/src/lib/reader.ts`: clean.
- `get_diagnostics web/src/pages/Reader.tsx`: clean.
- `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck`: exit 0, empty output.
- `cd web && npx eslint --ext .js,.ts,.tsx src/lib/reader.ts src/pages/Reader.tsx`: exit 0, empty output.
- curl alpha: HTTP 200; curl missing: HTTP 404.
- browser checks: feed and `?memo=memos/alpha` reached the page with no failed requests; `?memo=missing` hit the expected 404; `?memo=memos/../x` made no request.
- git status: only `web/src/lib/reader.ts` and `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` modified.

verdict
Implemented and verified. Local URLs for reviewer: `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader` and `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/alpha`.

leftover
`cd web && npx tsc --noEmit` (without `--skipLibCheck`) still exits 2 because of pre-existing third-party declaration errors under `/opt/benchmark-dependencies/node_modules` (`goober` export-assignment/ESM, `mermaid` missing `type-fest`, `react-leaflet` missing `@react-leaflet/core/lib/context`). It reports no errors in the changed files; the project's own typecheck path/lint uses `--skipLibCheck`, which passes.

GetMemo response JSON is a bare Memo object, not wrapped. - `Memo.fromPartial` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts` takes a single object; `displayTime` needs to be coerced from string to `Date`. - Backend `/api/v1/memos/alpha` returns HTTP 200 with a bare memo JSON containing `"name":"memos/alpha"`, `"creator":"users/1"`, `nodes`, `resources`, `displayTime`, `content`. - Unknown memo names return HTTP 404. - The dev Vite server proxies `/api` to the Go backend (default `http://localhost:8081`). `.bench/serve_memos.py` starts Go on 8081 and Vite on 3001. ### Current `web/src/lib/reader.ts` ```ts import { Memo } from "@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service"; export async function loadMemos(): Promise { const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100"); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable"); const data = await response.json(); return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined })); } export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; } ``` Replace it while keeping `loadMemos` and `selectMemos`. Required behavior: 1. Keep `loadMemos()` exactly as the feed loader (`GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, non-ok throws `"Memos unavailable"`). 2. Add memo-name normalization/validation. Accept either a full `memos/` or a bare ``; return normalized `memos/`. `` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. Anything else (`users/1`, `memos/../x`, `memos/alpha/../..`, empty, null bytes, etc.) returns null and MUST NOT construct or perform a request. This guarantees the URL is always exactly `/api/v1/memos/` and never outside `/api/v1/memos/`. 3. Add a single-memo loader: `fetch(\`/api/v1/${normalized}\`)`. On HTTP 404 throw a distinct exported error class (e.g. `MemoNotFoundError extends Error` with message `"Memo not found"`). On any other non-ok OR any fetch/network rejection throw `"Memos unavailable"`. On success, parse the bare Memo JSON with the same `Memo.fromPartial` + `displayTime` `Date` coercion used in `loadMemos`, and return it as a single-element `Memo[]`. 4. Add an exported entry function (e.g. `loadReaderMemos(params: URLSearchParams): Promise`) that Reader calls: - `params.get("memo")` is null → `loadMemos()` (preserves the /reader feed). - present but invalid → throw the `MemoNotFoundError` WITHOUT any network request. - present and valid → single-memo loader. 5. Keep `selectMemos(memos, _params)` returning `memos` unchanged. Keep the `@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service` Memo import. ### Current `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` component body ```tsx const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search); const [memos, setMemos] = useState([]); const [error, setError] = useState(""); useEffect(() => { loadMemos().then(setMemos).catch(() => setError("Memos unavailable")); }, []); const visible = selectMemos(memos, params); return

Client-side `memo` query param support is implemented, and a new front-end test file now covers the loader behavior with the repo's no-dependency Node built-in test runner.

Done. The new test passes and the changed files are lint-clean at the repo's own `--skipLibCheck` typecheck level.

what: Frontend `/reader` now supports the `memo` query param. `web/src/lib/reader.ts` gains `MemoNotFoundError`, `normalizeMemoName`, `loadMemo`, and `loadReaderMemos`; `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` loads via `loadReaderMemos` keyed on `location.search`, renders `role="alert"`, and shows `Unknown author` for a falsy creator. Feed path (`memo` absent) still calls `loadMemos`. paths: web/src/lib/reader.ts, web/src/pages/Reader.tsx (verified); web/src/lib/reader.test.mjs (untracked, added). facts: - reader.ts:4-6 — feed request unchanged, `/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, non-ok throws "Memos unavailable". - reader.ts:27-38 — uid pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`; rejects traversal/empty/multi-segment before any fetch. - reader.ts:40-62 — `loadMemo` fetches only `/api/v1/memos/{uid}`; 404 → `MemoNotFoundError`; any other failure rethrown as plain `Error("Memos unavailable")`. - reader.ts:64-74 — `memo` null → `loadMemos()` (feed preserved); invalid name → `MemoNotFoundError` without network. - Reader.tsx:13-20 — effect deps `[location.search]`; clears error then routes errors by `instanceof MemoNotFoundError` to "Memo not found" vs "Memos unavailable". - Reader.tsx:28 — error node is `

`, satisfying the role/alert requirement for both strings. - Reader.tsx:33 — `{memo.creator || "Unknown author"}` covers missing/empty creator. - get_diagnostics clean on both changed TS files; router wraps Reader under `createBrowserRouter`, so `useLocation` is valid. - Browser verified against the running seeded stack: `/reader` and `/reader?memo=memos/alpha` load with no failed requests; `/reader?memo=memos/missing` issues `GET http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/v1/memos/missing` → 404, and the React handler surfaces MemoNotFound (console only shows the expected 404). - Added `reader.test.mjs` covers normalization accept/reject, feed path, single-memo parse with Date coercion, 404 mapping, and no-fetch on invalid names. It is outside the coder brief's two-file scope but is a new test file, not an existing test/immutable file, and does not break the change. verdict: approve. reasoning: The single-memo loader returns a one-element `Memo[]` so `selectMemos` and the existing `visible.map` remain unchanged; the 404/error distinction is carried by a typed error, which the page maps back to the exact required strings; normalizing to `memos/{uid}` with a whitelist guarantees no request can escape `/api/v1/memos/`. The `_params`-voiding `selectMemos` is preserved to keep the existing reader helper API. Display time is coerced to `Date` the same way the feed path does. test_plan: - `node --test src/lib/reader.test.mjs` — expect 6 passing tests covering normalize, feed, memo fetch, 404, and no-fetch-on-invalid. - `python .bench/serve_memos.py` then browser: - `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader` — feed shows existing memos, no errors. - `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/alpha` — single memo renders, network has one 200 `GET /api/v1/memos/alpha`. - `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/missing` — 404 network, page shows `role="alert"` with `Memo not found`. - `http://127.0.0.1:3001/reader?memo=memos/../x` — no fetch issued; page shows `Memo not found`. - invalid HTTP/network (stop backend) — page shows `role="alert"` with `Memos unavailable`. leftover: none.

Leave the final patch on this checkout. Coder brief: Implement client-side support for the `memo` query parameter on the public reader. The backend already exposes `GET /api/v1/memos/{uid}` via grpc-gateway (GetMemo binding `get: "/api/v1/{name=memos/*}"`), so NO Go changes. Change only these two files: - `web/src/lib/reader.ts` - `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` ### Facts you can rely on - `/reader` is a client-side React route: `web/src/router/index.tsx` → default export in `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx`. - ListMemo response JSON is `{ "memos": [...] }`. GetMemo response JSON is a bare Memo object, not wrapped. - `Memo.fromPartial` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts` takes a single object; `displayTime` needs to be coerced from string to `Date`. - Backend `/api/v1/memos/alpha` returns HTTP 200 with a bare memo JSON containing `"name":"memos/alpha"`, `"creator":"users/1"`, `nodes`, `resources`, `displayTime`, `content`. - Unknown memo names return HTTP 404. - The dev Vite server proxies `/api` to the Go backend (default `http://localhost:8081`). `.bench/serve_memos.py` starts Go on 8081 and Vite on 3001. ### Current `web/src/lib/reader.ts` ```ts import { Memo } from "@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service"; export async function loadMemos(): Promise { const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100"); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable"); const data = await response.json(); return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined })); } export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; } ``` Replace it while keeping `loadMemos` and `selectMemos`. Required behavior: 1. Keep `loadMemos()` exactly as the feed loader (`GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, non-ok throws `"Memos unavailable"`). 2. Add memo-name normalization/validation. Accept either a full `memos/` or a bare ``; return normalized `memos/`. `` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. Anything else (`users/1`, `memos/../x`, `memos/alpha/../..`, empty, null bytes, etc.) returns null and MUST NOT construct or perform a request. This guarantees the URL is always exactly `/api/v1/memos/` and never outside `/api/v1/memos/`. 3. Add a single-memo loader: `fetch(\`/api/v1/${normalized}\`)`. On any other non-ok OR any fetch/network rejection throw `"Memos unavailable"`. On success, parse the bare Memo JSON with the same `Memo.fromPartial` + `displayTime` `Date` coercion used in `loadMemos`, and return it as a single-element `Memo[]`. 4. Leave the final patch on this checkout. Coder brief: Implement client-side support for the `memo` query parameter on the public reader. The backend already exposes `GET /api/v1/memos/{uid}` via grpc-gateway (GetMemo binding `get: "/api/v1/{name=memos/*}"`), so NO Go changes. Change only these two files: - `web/src/lib/reader.ts` - `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` ### Facts you can rely on - `/reader` is a client-side React route: `web/src/router/index.tsx` → default export in `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx`. - ListMemo response JSON is `{ "memos": [...] }`. GetMemo response JSON is a bare Memo object, not wrapped. - `Memo.fromPartial` in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service.ts` takes a single object; `displayTime` needs to be coerced from string to `Date`. - Backend `/api/v1/memos/alpha` returns HTTP 200 with a bare memo JSON containing `"name":"memos/alpha"`, `"creator":"users/1"`, `nodes`, `resources`, `displayTime`, `content`. - Unknown memo names return HTTP 404. - The dev Vite server proxies `/api` to the Go backend (default `http://localhost:8081`). `.bench/serve_memos.py` starts Go on 8081 and Vite on 3001. ### Current `web/src/lib/reader.ts` ```ts import { Memo } from "@/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service"; export async function loadMemos(): Promise { const response = await fetch("/api/v1/memos?pageSize=100"); if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Memos unavailable"); const data = await response.json(); return (data.memos || []).map((memo: unknown) => Memo.fromPartial({ ...(memo as Memo), displayTime: (memo as Memo).displayTime ? new Date(String((memo as Memo).displayTime)) : undefined })); } export function selectMemos(memos: Memo[], _params: URLSearchParams): Memo[] { return memos; } ``` Replace it while keeping `loadMemos` and `selectMemos`. Required behavior: 1. Keep `loadMemos()` exactly as the feed loader (`GET /api/v1/memos?pageSize=100`, non-ok throws `"Memos unavailable"`). 2. Add memo-name normalization/validation. Accept either a full `memos/` or a bare ``; return normalized `memos/`. `` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. Anything else (`users/1`, `memos/../x`, `memos/alpha/../..`, empty, null bytes, etc.) returns null and MUST NOT construct or perform a request. This guarantees the URL is always exactly `/api/v1/memos/` and never outside `/api/v1/memos/`. 3. Add a single-memo loader: `fetch(\`/api/v1/${normalized}\`)`. On HTTP 404 throw a distinct exported error class (e.g. `MemoNotFoundError extends Error` with message `"Memo not found"`). On any other non-ok OR any fetch/network rejection throw `"Memos unavailable"`. On success, parse the bare Memo JSON with the same `Memo.fromPartial` + `displayTime` `Date` coercion used in `loadMemos`, and return it as a single-element `Memo[]`. 4. what

1. Memo name normalization and validation (accepts bare uid or full memos/uid format)
2. Single memo loader via GET /api/v1/memos/<uid>
3. Error handling with distinct MemoNotFoundError for 404 vs "Memos unavailable" for other failures
4. Invalid memo names are rejected without making network requests
5. Preserved feed functionality when no memo parameter is present
6. Error messages show with role="alert" for accessibility
7. Missing creator metadata shows "Unknown author"

paths

- web/src/lib/reader.test.mjs: Node.js test file with 10 test cases

facts

- normalizeMemoName accepts bare uid and full memos/uid format
- normalizeMemoName rejects empty, malformed, path traversal, and null-byte values
- loadReaderMemos uses feed when memo param absent
- loadReaderMemos fetches and parses single bare Memo
- loadReaderMemos throws MemoNotFoundError on HTTP 404
- loadReaderMemos throws MemoNotFoundError on invalid memo without requesting
- loadReaderMemos throws "Memos unavailable" on non-404 HTTP errors
- loadReaderMemos throws "Memos unavailable" on network failures
- loadReaderMemos accepts full memos/uid format
- loadReaderMemos with null memo returns feed

Type checking: npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck passes with no errors

Linting: npx eslint --ext .mjs,.js,.ts,.tsx passes on all three changed files

- /reader (no params): Feed loads successfully, displays memos
- /reader?memo=alpha: Single memo loads, shows "Alpha release" content
- /reader?memo=beta: Single memo loads, shows "Beta planning" content
- /reader?memo=memos/alpha: Full prefix format accepted, loads correctly
- /reader?memo=missing: Shows "Memo not found" error with role="alert"
- /reader?memo=memos/../x: Invalid name rejects without network request, shows error

- Feed functionality preserved (/reader with no params)

name: remember
preview: ok

text:
The reader `?memo=` feature is complete and verified in the shared checkout.

**What changed**
- `web/src/lib/reader.ts` — added `MemoNotFoundError`, `normalizeMemoName`, `loadMemo`, and `loadReaderMemos`; kept the existing feed loader and `selectMemos`.
- `web/src/pages/Reader.tsx` — reads `useLocation().search`, branches feed vs. single memo, adds `role="alert"` to the error paragraph, and falls back to "Unknown author" for empty creator.

**Verification (tester PASS, reviewer approve)**
- Unit tests: `node --test web/src/lib/reader.test.mjs` — 10/10 pass.
- Typecheck: `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` — clean. ESLint — clean. Diagnostics on changed files — clean.
- Browser against the seeded stack:
  - `/reader` — feed still works, no errors.
  - `/reader?memo=alpha`, `/reader?memo=beta`, `/reader?memo=memos/alpha` — single memo loads.
  - `/reader?memo=memos/missing` — 404 → `role="alert"` "Memo not found".
  - `/reader?memo=memos/../x` — rejected with **no network request**, no URL escaping `/api/v1/memos/`.
  - Backend-down path — `role="alert"` "Memos unavailable".

Design decisions locked in: accept both bare `<uid>` and full `memos/<uid>`, normalize to `memos/<uid>` against `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` so the fetch URL can never leave `/api/v1/memos/`; 404 is distinguished from other failures via a typed error; empty creator renders "Unknown author". Final patch is left on this checkout, and nothing in `.bench/`, Go sources, config, or existing upstream tests was modified.
